limiterDetail: Wind is fine for now (5.7–11.7 kt, ECMWF day 7.6 kt, gusts 14) and rain is light. The main limiter this afternoon is current: Tara, Turda, Decabaitot, Alava and Culion run 1.0–1.6 kt. From about Thu 1 AM it becomes a current plus wind problem, with 12–16 kt on the Maglalambay, Panlaitan, Alava and Binudac side.

pagasa.status: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA.
pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest: Tropical Cyclone Warning, Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi) , Wed 21 Oct 10:51 AM PHT: Signal #2 for Batanes , Signal #1 for Ilocos Norte, Apayao, Cagayan, Isabela and Catanduanes. Rosal is 845 km east of Northern Luzon (215 kph winds), moving WNW, and exits PAR by Sat 24. Gale Warning No. 2 covers the northern and eastern seaboards of Luzon and the eastern seaboard of Visayas only. Strong to gale-force gusts are forecast for most of Luzon and Visayas Thu 22 and Fri 23.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The afternoon current build arrived as forecast , so the grounds snapshot slipped from 7 GOOD / 7 MARGINAL / 2 POOR to 1 GOOD / 10 MARGINAL / 4 POOR / 1 VERY POOR. Tara is now VERY POOR (1.6 kt, holding 1.5–1.7 for the next 24h), and Culion, Decabaitot and Alava dropped to POOR on 1.0–1.1 kt. Only Panlaitan is still GOOD. The overall day stays MARGINAL.

Supply timing is unchanged: Thursday is still the worst fishing day (POOR, 11 kt, gusts 17), so arrivals thin out around Fri 23. The weekend got a little better: Sun 25 is now the calmest day (4.7 kt, rain down to ~2.0 mm), while Mon 26 picks up moderate rain (~6.6 mm, gusts 16).

PAGASA raised Signal #2 for Batanes (10:51 AM PHT) as Super Typhoon Rosal (Champi) sits 845 km east of Northern Luzon. Still nothing for Palawan, but the strong-to-gale gust warning covers most of Luzon and Visayas on Thu 22 and Fri 23.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). Shortage risk stays ELEVATED (guide only), with the tightest arrivals Thu 22 to Fri 23. Tara, Turda and Decabaitot run BELOW NORMAL locally on current. Buying from today's and tonight's landings is still the best move before Friday thins out.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight about 7–11 PM (Coron side), then Thu 7 AM–noon
details: 7–11 PM tonight: Coron, Galoc and Culion-side wind drops to 6 kt, with Coron and Galoc current easing to 0.4–0.5 kt by 9–11 PM. Ciron is also workable (7 kt, 0.5 kt).
Thu 7 AM–noon: Coron and Galoc on 0.3 kt current and 9–11 kt wind, the best combination of the next 24h, with a light shower (0.6 mm/h) around 6–8 AM.

Keep boats off Tara all 24h and off Turda, Decabaitot and Alava tonight. Thursday 1–8 AM brings 12–16 kt to Maglalambay, Panlaitan, Alava, Binudac and Linapacan, so early Thursday trips there will be rough.
